nodes.question: What effect does full submersion of specimens during freeze-thaw cycles have compared to just having water on top?
nodes.answer: Full submersion induces more internal cracks than solely having water on top during freeze-thaw cycles.
nodes.paragraph: Full submersion of specimens during FTCs induced more internal cracks than solely water on top. These findings on the interactions between pre-damage, water boundary conditions, and inter - nal frost damage offer insight into the causes of frost damage, vital for the design and assessment of con- crete structures in frost-prone environments. Fur - thermore, the results of these dual-scale tests can be used as a test case for the development of upscaling numerical models describing heat transfer and frost degradation in concrete.
